errors.RATE_LIMITED: That's a lot of Secret Santas for one day. Try again tomorrow.
errors.DATE_IN_PAST: Gift day can't be in the past.
errors.INVALID_INPUT: Something in the form doesn't look right. Check the fields and try again.
errors.UNAUTHENTICATED: Your sign-in expired. Send yourself a new code.
errors.INTERNAL: Something went wrong on our side. Try again in a moment.

explain.secretSanta: Everyone secretly draws one name and gets that person a gift. Nobody knows who their Santa is until gift day.
explain.whiteElephant: Everyone brings one wrapped gift to a shared pile. Take turns: unwrap a new one, or steal a gift someone already opened.
explain.conspiracy: Everyone gets one gift from all the others. You plan each person's gift together, on a board that person can't see.

organizer.name: Your name
organizer.name-help: Everyone in the Secret Santa sees this name.
organizer.email-help: We'll send you a code to check it's you. Nothing gets sent to anyone else.
